verdict.rationale: The main concrete evidence of bulk-style operations is the PDF skill's ability to 'merge multiple PDFs' and scripts bundled within skill directories, suggesting skills can encapsulate scripted batch logic. There is no broader documentation of bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch processing datasets, mass file transforms, iterating operations at scale) as a core capability of the Skills framework itself. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch-processing examples across many items, documentation of scaling behavior for large item sets, and independent confirmation that skills reliably execute such operations.
